headline: 🔴 FBI seizes Flax Typhoon's MicroScan/FishHub domains with 7-nation advisory, 🐙 FakeGit swells to 17,610 malicious GitHub repos, 💥 New NetScaler 9.5 SAML RCE plus Ahsay and Atlassian exploited in the wild, 🏯 Ransomware cripples Japan's IDCF Cloud, 495 tenants down, 🤖 AI pentest tool ARTEX hits 7 South Korean banks, 🔐 IBM Verify Access and DataPower 9.8 RCE waves
summary: A seven-domain seizure against Flax Typhoon's Integrity Technology Group tooling leads a day defined by developer-supply-chain scale, with FakeGit's 17,610-repo GitHub fleet and in-the-wild exploitation of NetScaler, Ahsay backup and Atlassian flaws driving urgent patching.

Novel TTP: fleet reactivated Oct 4 to 17,610 repos at a 2,999/hour peak with agentbaiting of AI/MCP registries; severity-weighted prior underranks supply-chain scale.
Huntress documents in-the-wild exploitation of backup software, a ransomware-precursor class the 3.9 prior undervalues.
Precursor signal: autonomous pentest tool used at scale against 7 banks, leaked Claude/DeepSeek session files as forensic anchor, repo star growth after attribution.
